description: This source file implements the NvidiaLLMService class, which extends an OpenAI-compatible LLM service to interact with NVIDIA's NIM API. It manages token usage metrics, especially handling incremental token reporting specific to NVIDIA's API, and provides methods for initializing the service and processing context for inference.
